neighbours.label: ' all' as a determiner over a whole collection ('all the latest news', 'all its members', 'all the files'), vs fixed or adverbial 'all' ('all day', 'at all', 'after all', 'all right')
fire: Subscribe to the newsletter to keep up with all the latest updates.
The rules apply equally to all the members of the club.
She backed up all the files before reinstalling the system.
Sign up now to get all the latest deals delivered to your inbox.
The festival celebrates traditions shared by all the villages in the valley.
Our guide covers all the best beaches on the island.
The teacher collected all the essays at the end of class.
Follow the blog for all the newest recipes and tips.
quiet: Subscribe to the newsletter, or you will not hear from us at all.
The rules seemed strange, but after all, it was only a game.
She worked on the files all morning before reinstalling the system.
Sign up now, and it will be all right if you cancel later.
The festival lasted all week in the villages of the valley.
Our guide was not worried at all about the weather on the island.
The teacher stayed calm all afternoon at the end of the term.
Follow the blog if you like, it is free after all.

predictions: Fire items 0.2-0.6 near ' all'; near misses under 0.08. Mixed probe evidence; may fail.
notes: Card: ' all' x12, ' both' x3, ' every' x2 quantifying members of a group.
